name: Consistencia de Temas
description: Measures topic consistency throughout the text.
useCase: Detecting AI text through unnaturally consistent topics
mechanism: Compares histogram distributions between content segments using cosine similarity. AI text maintains extremely consistent topic signals throughout.
source: Bakhtin et al. (2019) - Real or Fake? Learning to Discriminate Machine from Human Text
parameters: Window size: adaptive, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropy, CV, correlation
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated text
- Language-agnostic statistical approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger false positives
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies across writing styles

references.title: Bakhtin et al. (2019) - Real or Fake? Learning to Discriminate Machine from Human Text
Zellers, R. et al. (2019). Defending Against Neural Fake News. NeurIPS.
Jawahar, G. et al. (2020). Automatic Detection of Machine Generated Text: A Critical Survey. COLING.
